title: Pickup slots
intro: Slots are short windows inside your pickup hours. Each slot takes a limited number of orders so nobody queues for long. A full slot is greyed out for customers.

noMarkets.title: You are not selling at any market yet
noMarkets.text: Join a market under Stall & pickup, then come back here to open pickup slots.

noDays.title: This market has no pickup days set
noDays.text: Set the days and pickup window for this market under Stall & pickup, then generate slots for them here.

table.belowBooked: That is fewer than the orders already in this slot.
table.closedText: This slot is off and no longer takes orders. This screen cannot turn it back on yet; contact the team if you need it reopened.
table.reenableNote: A slot you turn off drops off this list, the same way it drops off the market page. There is no way to turn it back on from here yet; <link>contact the team</link> if you need it reopened.

empty.title: No slots for this day
empty.text: Generate the slots for a market day and customers can start booking a pickup time.

defaults.title: Defaults
defaults.note: Change the window and days under Stall & pickup. Slots for a day are created from them.

closing.title: Closing a slot
closing.text: Turning a slot off hides it from new orders. Orders already in it stay; contact those customers if you cannot make it.

generate.title: Generate slots at {{market}}
generate.rangeError: Pick an end date on or after the start date.
